title: playtest my isometric boss rush game, with your friends
author: blessed--
selftext:
Check out my game [Rift Crashers](https://monkeymindproductions.itch.io/rift-crashers?password=riftcrashing)

send the url to your friends, give them a code, host up and you can play with them

it's a boss rush game, i enjoy patterns and raid style movement. made it for fun with my homies and they said it was genuinely fun so here i am putting in a bit more effort

i have primarily worked in unity, i wanted to try out three.js. I was able to import a lot of my existing paid and generated assets, and have a lot more flexibility, to be honest it was a breath of fresh air. 

i was a month deep in a unity RPG and felt like i hit a wall, what i was making wasn't cool anymore. it be like that sometimes

anyway, i hope you enjoy it

feedback is desired in any form, and can answer any questions
